items.html: And if you should say: there is a great distance between the vessel of Da'at and its light, seven Sefirot of Atzilut, for its light stands above, in the Da'at of Atzilut — one may answer that even within the Sefirot of Atzilut themselves there is not such a great loss, except that between the light and the vessel there is a measure of three empty Sefirot with no light at all, neither the light itself nor another. But here, although its own light rose above, there are other lights standing at the end of Atzilut, close to Beria, and it can receive illumination from them, and it can also receive illumination from its own light, by means of those lights that are close to it. Remember this rule for all the other Sefirot as well, for there are never more than three empty Sefirot of Atzilut between the vessel and the light, and we shall not need to repeat this matter for each one of them.
